Lakeside A-Frame at Loon Point

• Classic 1970s A-frame right on the shore of Loon Lake, with a private dock
• 3 bedrooms, 2 baths, loft with reading nook
• Sleeps 7
• Check-in 3 PM / Check-out 11 AM
• Kayaks, canoe, and life jackets included
• Fire pit and gas grill
• Wi-Fi and a smart TV
• No smoking
• No fireworks
• Dogs welcome, max 2
• $210/night, $95 cleaning
